title: Aureline M5 supported-line stale-escalation blocker
description: Canonical per-domain stale-escalation record minted by the retention-policy and stale-escalation lane over the frozen M5 supported-line-transparency matrix. Raises one typed blocker when a B147 supported-line proof artifact falls out of its review cadence, so automation can detect a missing scheduled snapshot or a stale line feed and block a supported-line claim before it stays green on expired evidence. Each escalation names the escalation scope it fires for — a missing scheduled snapshot (a required monthly or per-train snapshot never published), a stale line feed (a published snapshot past its retention/review window), or a matrix mismatch (a snapshot inconsistent with the active supported-line matrix) — binds the affected artifact-class reference and the active supported-line matrix reference it is checked against, records the active escalation reason, and states whether it still blocks the supported-line claim. Escalations are joined to exact build / release-line identity so a blocker always names which build and supported line it fired for. Raw secret values, private endpoints, and privileged incident / security internals never cross this boundary.
